package gov.moh.platform.common.util.text;

import static java.util.Locale.ROOT;

import java.text.Normalizer;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

/**
 * Text normalisation shared by every platform module (common-lib).
 */
public final class TextNormalizer {

    private static final Pattern WHITESPACE = Pattern.compile("\\s+");
    private static final Pattern DIACRITICS = Pattern.compile("\\p{M}+");

    private TextNormalizer() {
        throw new AssertionError("no instances");
    }

    /** Collapses runs of whitespace and trims; {@code null} stays {@code null}. */
    public static String collapseWhitespace(final String input) {
        return input == null ? null : WHITESPACE.matcher(input.trim()).replaceAll(" ");
    }

    public static String foldForSearch(final String input) {
        if (input == null) {
            return "";
        }
        final String decomposed = Normalizer.normalize(input, Normalizer.Form.NFD);
        return collapseWhitespace(DIACRITICS.matcher(decomposed).replaceAll("")).toLowerCase(ROOT);
    }
}
